architecture_decisions: 4.1 Owner-scoped observability service A narrow service accepts an owner-scoped Engineering Run service/repository plus #145 `RunEventRepository` and the durable lineage store. It resolves the run first and derives canonical `project_id`; caller-provided Project identity is never an authorization input.
work_items: 4.2 Event replay endpoint Provide an authenticated endpoint under the Engineering Run surface that returns bounded events with: - exact `id`, `project_id`, `run_id`, positive `sequence` and deterministic `event_key`; - typed `event_type`, `stage`, `outcome`, `subsystem`; - safe optional attempt/worker/lineage/operation/artifact/evidence/failure references; - bounded summary/metadata; - `occurred_at` and durable `created_at`; - `next_after_sequence` and `has_more` derived without inventing events.
validations: 4.3 SSE transport Provide an authenticated SSE endpoint for one exact run. It returns bounded events with: - exact `id`, `project_id`, `run_id`, positive `sequence` and deterministic `event_key`; - typed `event_type`, `stage`, `outcome`, `subsystem`; - safe optional attempt/worker/lineage/operation/artifact/evidence/failure references; - bounded summary/metadata; - `occurred_at` and durable `created_at`; - `next_after_sequence` and `has_more` derived without inventing events.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Authenticated JSON replay resolves the canonical owner-scoped run first and returns ascending durable #145 events after a nonnegative cursor with bounded limits and stable public identities.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — The authenticated SSE route replays persisted events after its resolved cursor, emits durable sequence IDs, observes newly committed events through bounded polling and survives process recreation without process-local event authority.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Valid `Last-Event-ID` takes precedence over the query cursor, invalid headers fail closed, and permanent tests prove reconnect/replay cannot cause duplicate rendered event identity when the client helper tracks the last accepted sequence.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Connect, keepalive, disconnect, reconnect, timeout and stream failure never pause/cancel/advance a run, acquire/reassign a worker, mutate source, publish a provider action or fabricate run-event success.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Tree reads require an exact lineage belonging to the owner-scoped Project/run and expose only bounded immutable manifest metadata protected by the existing lineage source-path policy.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — A requested relative path must be policy-valid and present in the exact lineage. Returned text must match immutable object digest/size and response bounds; binary/oversized/secret/traversal inputs never return raw content.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Diffs require two exact same-run lineages, report deterministic added/removed/changed results, explicitly mark binary/oversized/truncated cases and cannot be applied as a mutation request.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Read-only attempt evidence is owner scoped and allowlisted. BUILD/TEST/VERIFY may expose bounded already-persisted execution excerpts/digests and identities, while arbitrary commands, raw environment, credentials, provider payloads, prompts/reasoning and unbounded logs remain absent.
AC-09: validate protected requirement — Tests prove another owner, wrong Project/run, foreign lineage, foreign attempt, invalid path and malformed cursor cannot reveal protected existence or content.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Repository/object/evidence failures, cursor errors and diff truncation remain explicit observation failures/states and cannot change authoritative runtime outcomes or be represented as engineering success.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Deterministic tests cover JSON paging, SSE replay/live polling/reconnect, client deduplication, process-recreated repository reads, disconnect independence, source/file/diff bounds, secret-path denial, binary behavior, evidence allowlisting and cross-scope isolation.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — The final candidate has authentic committed DSPy plan evidence and passes Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI and Bounded Autonomy on the exact final head with existing Wave 3/#145 protected suites unchanged or stronger. The worker stops review-ready before merge, migration application or deployment.
risks: 4.4 Observer independence. Stream connect, disconnect, timeout or retry has no Engineering Run/worker mutation effect.
